recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆淋巴芽細胞：體積小到中等（約為紅血球的 1.5–2 倍），細胞質極少、無顆粒，核圓、染色質均勻細緻但偏濃，下方那顆可見小核仁，這種高核質比、無顆粒的芽細胞是 ALL 的典型形態。
features: Two small to medium blasts, about 1.5–2 times the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely stippled, homogeneous but moderately condensed chromatin
Small, inconspicuous nucleolus in the lower cell
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells normochromic; occasional platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratios, scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei with finely stippled homogeneous chromatin, and a small inconspicuous nucleolus in the lower cell. No Auer rods or granules are seen. The background red cells are normochromic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts; flow cytometric immunophenotyping (TdT, CD34, CD19/CD10 or cytoplasmic CD3) is required to confirm B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, more open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and may show granules or Auer rods, with MPO positivity.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, block-like clumped chromatin without nucleoli and are TdT/CD34 negative.
Hematogones are rarely seen in blood, have very homogeneous smooth chromatin and show a normal maturation pattern of CD10/CD20/CD34 on flow.
